sections.title: Form and colour
sections.text: Magellanic bog-moss forms robust shoots and dense, low to moderately raised cushions. Colour ranges from green in shade to pink, red or purplish in open growth; the red cushions in the plate match this characteristic range.

sections.title: Name and habitat
sections.text: The species grows in bogs. Its name has been applied broadly in older literature, but modern taxonomic work restricts S. magellanicum in the strict sense to southern South America; northern plants once placed here are treated as other species. A plate alone cannot establish a specimen’s identity.

sections.title: Use and safety
sections.text: It contributes to peat formation and water retention. It is not a food plant; avoid harvesting wild peat moss from natural bogs.
